title: Pin rakazo's docker commands to the OrbStack context — global context flipped to a dead Docker Desktop socket
description: Measured 2026-09-10 ~20:10 on mac-studio: docker current context = desktop-linux (unix:///Users/luke/.docker/run/docker.sock, file absent) while OrbStack runs the Postgres container on 127.0.0.1:5434 via context orbstack. rakazo itself stayed healthy, but ops/start-rakazo.sh (and ~/dev/rakazo-setup/start-rakazo.sh, APPLY.md steps, backup commands) call plain 'docker compose', which fails whenever something changes the global context. Fix: export DOCKER_CONTEXT=orbstack at the top of ops/start-rakazo.sh and every documented docker command in APPLY.md, and mirror into ~/dev/rakazo-setup/start-rakazo.sh; do not change the global context. AC: with the global context left at desktop-linux, ~/dev/rakazo-setup/start-rakazo.sh brings the stack up and 'docker compose ... ps' in APPLY works; /health 200.
